title: FBI-UAP-D018, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-3, Western United States Event, 2023

pages.description: A dark nocturnal landscape scene showing two human figures in silhouette, seen from behind, standing on a foreground ridge or plateau. Both figures are outlined with a faint yellowish glow along their edges; the left figure appears taller and wears a jacket and pants, while the right figure appears shorter. They face toward a low range of rocky hills or mountains that stretch across the middle of the image. The sky above is deep blue-black and filled with many small stars. In the upper right portion of the sky hovers a bright glowing orb with a yellow outer halo and a red-orange center, appearing luminous against the dark sky. The overall lighting is dim, suggesting nighttime in a desert or arid environment.

observations.claim: Two human figures are shown in silhouette from behind
Both figures have a faint yellow glowing outline along their edges
A glowing orb with a yellow halo and red center appears in the upper right sky
The sky is dark blue-black and contains numerous stars
A range of low rocky hills spans the middle of the image
The left figure is taller than the right figure
No legible text is present in the image
